utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Tess. I’ll do the same and let you know if anything shifts before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa. I appreciate it, and I’ll pass along any updates if anything changes before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Vik. Please be on the front porch at 9 a.m. with the screwdriver and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I can do that. I’ll be on the front porch at 9 with the screwdriver and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’ll bring a few basic tools on Saturday and help check who’s available so we can get enough hands for the porch repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. That helps a lot, and I’m grateful you’ll check who’s available too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little concerned we may be short-handed, so I want to keep the Saturday porch repair plan tight. Tell me what still needs covering and I’ll help sort the list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We still need someone to keep tools organized and someone to greet folks as they arrive. I’ll be there at 9 a.m. on the front porch with a screwdriver and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive on Saturday at the front porch, I can help for a while. Just remind me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Bring the drill if you have one, and maybe some extra gloves. I’ll be on the front porch at 9 a.m. with a screwdriver and gloves, ready to get it started.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Sam, I’ve got the Saturday repair drive lined up at the front porch, and I’ll let you know if anything changes before then.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess. I’ll keep an eye out for Saturday updates and help round up a few more hands if needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Vik. I’ve got you down for 9 a.m. on the front porch, and the screwdriver and gloves will help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good, Mina. I’ll be there at 9 with my toolbox and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m mostly worried we’ll be short-handed, so I’m keeping it small and manageable. If you can check who’s free for Saturday, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can check who’s free and see who might help on Saturday. I’ll keep it simple and let you know what I find.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
